reason: A browser-side DSH Web UI plugin that visualizes session execution status through a docked progress bar, including todo progress, timing, estimated token rate, completion, interruption, and pending-interaction states.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面输入框停靠区显示会话进度、耗时、估算生成速率以及完成、中断和待处理交互状态。
summaries.en: Displays session progress, elapsed time, estimated generation rate, and completion, interruption, and pending-interaction states in the DSH Web UI input dock.

capabilities: Reads DSH session snapshots and todo state in the browser
Renders a persistent session progress bar in the Web UI
Displays elapsed time, optional ETA, estimated token generation rate, completion, interruption, and pending-interaction states
